short_description: J1 is a sativa-dominant hybrid with an energetic reputation.
description: Leafly describes J1 as a hybrid strain. Users report feeling energetic and focused. It helps with depression and stress relief for many patients. Leafly lists a reported 18% THC. J1 takes 9 weeks to flower. The aroma is described as skunky and sweet.

claims.sentence: Leafly describes J1 as a hybrid strain.
